entities.summary: María del Carmen Alva Prieto is a Peruvian lawyer and politician who served as the president of the Congress of the Republic of Peru from 26 July 2021 until 26 July 2022, and a member of the Congress representing Lima. She is a member of Popular Action. Maricarmen Alva was a legal figures from Lima (b. 1967-02-24, Lima). A moderately significant entity in the historical record. Relevant to cause-and-effect analysis.
